item.title: Road Trips Opening Reception at Archway Gallery
item.description:
Saturday, August 1, 2026 at 5 PM

Location: Archway Gallery, 2305 Dunlavy St, Houston, TX, 77006, United States

Now celebrating its fiftieth year, the member-owned Montrose gallery hosts a free opening reception for Road Trips, an exhibit featuring new paintings by Lisette McClung. This exhibit brings together a collection of both plein air and studio works—large and small—inspired by her many road trips over the past decade. Plein air—French for “open air”—refers to the practice of painting outdoors on location. As a dedicated plein air painter, McClung has been invited to paint, explore, and photograph on a variety of working ranches, as well as in fields, cities, and villages across the United States and Europe. There will be an artist talk at 6:30pm. Complimentary valet parking and light refreshments available. The exhibit will be on display from Saturday, August 1 through Thursday, September 3, 2026. Opened in 1976, Archway Gallery is currently celebrating its fiftieth year. Admission Free. Learn more. If you visit Archway Gallery’s website before the exhibition opens, be sure to click on “Exhibitions” in the top menu bar, then on “Upcoming Exhibitions”, to find details on this exhibit. “Running Wild” by Lisette McClung | Photos courtesy of Archway Gallery This Featured Calendar Listing was sponsored by the event organizer and boosted in our calendar with images and more details. item.title: Bun B Presents Been Ridin' Dirty at Smart Financial Centre
item.description:
Saturday, August 1, 2026 at 8 PM

Location: Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land, 18111 Lexington Blvd, Sugar Land, TX, 77479, United States

Smart Financial Centre welcomes Bun B Presents Been Ridin’ Dirty—a one-night only live show commemorating the 30th anniversary of U.G.K.’s landmark 1996 album Ridin’ Dirty—on the Sugar Land stage. Bun B will joined on stage by special guests Big K.R.I.T., Lil’ Keke, Slim Thug, David Banner, 8Ball & MJG, LE$, Chamillionaire, Killa Kyleon, Botany boyz, Z-ro, Devin the Dude, and more. Widely regarded as a defining work in Southern hip hop, Ridin’ Dirty introduced a sound while capturing a distinct cultural point of view at a pivotal moment in the genre’s evolution. The evening will unfold as a complete presentation of Ridin’ Dirty, performed in sequence & interpreted through a thoughtfully constructed live production. Each track is situated within a broader narrative, drawing from the environments & lived experiences that informed the album, offering a cohesive, start-to-finish reflection of its impact. Bun B will be at the center of the performance, anchoring the night not only as an artist, but as a steward of the legacy. Admission Tickets start at $35. Order tickets or learn more. item.title: Dream Retirement: Make Your Money Last Strategy Evening in Kingwood
item.description:
Wednesday, August 5, 2026 at 7 PM

Location: Courtyard by Marriott Houston Kingwood, 130 Northpark Plaza Dr, Kingwood, TX, 77339, United States

Be Retirement Prepared presents the free, educational Dream Retirement: Make Your Money Last Strategy Evening at Courtyard by Marriott Houston Kingwood. The evening will cover portfolio strategy, withdrawal sequencing, and the tactics that determine whether your money sustains 30+ years of retirement. The primary concern for pre-retirees is ensuring their wealth lasts throughout retirement. Whether you already work with an advisor or manage your own investments, a second perspective on your withdrawal plan can add real years to your retirement. Highlights Portfolio strategy designed for retirement income, not growth Withdrawal sequencing that determines how long your money lasts How early market downturns impact your long-term retirement plan Rebalancing discipline during market volatility Diversification strategies beyond stocks and bonds There will be no pressure and nothing is sold, just clear guidance and a chance to get your questions answered. Seating is limited, so reservations are recommended. Doors open at 6:45pm. Admission Free with RSVP. item.title: 52nd Annual Houston Shakespeare Festival: The Tempest at Miller Outdoor Theatre
item.description:
Wednesday, August 5, 2026 at 8:15 PM

Location: Miller Outdoor Theatre, 6000 Hermann Park Dr, Houston, TX, 77030, United States

Houston Shakespeare Festival, the city’s annual summer theater tradition, celebrates its 52nd season with performances of both The Tempest and Comedy of Errors on alternating nights at Miller Outdoor Theatre. Shakespeare’s The Tempest Exiled by her brother to a remote island and left to die, Prospera—the once loved Duchess of Milan and now an all-powerful sorceress—conjures a great tempest to wash ashore a ship of her enemies. With the power of magic, Prospera manipulates the survivors of the wreckage to weave a story of revenge, retribution, and reconciliation. Rich with spectacle, humor and wonder, Shakespeare’s final play brings audiences to a “brave new world ” where reconciliation is possible and humanity is renewed. Finding Your Seat at Miller Outdoor Theatre As always, all seats at Miller are free, but covered seating for popular evening shows usually requires a free assigned ticket reserved 24 hours in advance.
